cause_subject: perf: inline range expansion in the hot paths
bug_report: SUM over a range is wrong when the range contains a computed (formula) cell. For example with A1=1, A2==1+1, A3=3, the formula =SUM(A1:A3) returns 4 instead of 6 — the formula cell A2 is being skipped. Plain numeric ranges are fine. This regressed after recent performance work. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py. Fix it so ranges use the computed value of every cell, without breaking existing behaviour.
